objective: Determine whether a Festool product variant belonging to the 'Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag' product family and having storage type 'tool bag' exists in the catalogue.

params.exists: Query product_variants joined with product_families on product_family_id and product_variant_properties on product_sku, filtering by brand='Festool', product_family_name containing 'Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM', property_key='storage_type', and property_value_text='tool bag'. Return true if count > 0, else false.
